incidents.name: FIL314 public hourBurn()
incidents.notes: FIL314.hourBurn() is callable by anyone and burns FIL314 held by the FIL314/WBNB pair, so the attacker repeatedly shrank the pool and sold its position into the inflated price.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0xe8a290c6fc6fa6c0b79c9cfae1878d195aeb59af created 2024-04-12T08:02:59Z by 0x75996aa4b6e9a509ce5c6be83d8f587221898e05, which is not the attack-tx sender 0x4645863205b47a0a3344684489e8c446a437d66c; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain). ~14 BNB x $614.46/BNB at the incident timestamp 1712927609 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $8,602.
